::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
SMIC's largest single fab commitment — a $8.87B, 100,000 wafer/month 28nm-and-below joint venture with the Shanghai municipal government in the Lingang Special Area, formally incorporated as Zhongxin Dongfang Integrated Circuit Manufacturing Co. (中芯东方集成电路制造有限公司).
:::

**Chinese name:** 中芯临港 (Zhōngxīn Língǎng)

## What does this facility make?

12-inch (300mm) wafers at 28nm and more mature process nodes for foundry customers.

## Why does it matter?

Part of SMIC's 2020-2022 wave of four mega-fab JVs (Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, Shenzhen) aimed at building mature-node capacity for domestic demand, launched in the same window SMIC itself was added to the US Entity List.

## Project Timeline

- **Sep 2021** — SMIC signs cooperation agreement with the Shanghai Lingang Management Committee for a $8.87 billion, 100,000 wafer/month 12-inch fab; registered capital $5.5 billion, SMIC holding no less than 51%
- **Nov 2021** — Joint venture formally incorporated as Zhongxin Dongfang Integrated Circuit Manufacturing Co. (中芯东方集成电路制造有限公司)
